scientific_question: Does calibration-only selective promotion of the source-symmetric sequential EOG contextual representation improve untouched real ecological prediction relative to the same frozen conventional baseline?

published_dataset.required_future_identity: Dryad immutable version id plus file id and published digest/digestType (or equivalent immutable file identifier) must be frozen from metadata before response access

independent_documentation.article_title: Edge effects reduce persistence but not colonization in a declining Setophaga virens (Black-throated Green Warbler) population in Alberta's boreal forest

geometry_world_rule.pairwise_pool: all unordered distinct-site pairs among the 114 frozen site coordinates; discard only nonfinite or exactly zero distances
geometry_world_rule.quantile_method: linear interpolation with h=(n-1)*q, lower=floor(h), upper=ceil(h), value=x[lower]+(h-lower)*(x[upper]-x[lower]) on sorted nonzero distances

raw_detection_values.0: species not detected on a conducted visit

response_semantics_frozen_from_independe.binary_endpoint_rule: 1 if any conducted visit in that site-year has y==1; 0 if at least one visit was conducted and every conducted visit has y==0; ineligible if all visits are NA
response_semantics_frozen_from_independe.stored_derived_indicator_documentation: 1 if species detected at least once that year, 0 if never detected

independent_pre_response_class_support.published_sampling_statement: 3-5 point-count visits per site per year; analysis uses up to four repeat visits per site-year
independent_pre_response_class_support.interpretation: Independent publication evidence establishes a non-degenerate target with substantial occupied and unoccupied support at both ends of the 25-year record, unlike the MAPPPD extreme class-skew failure. These publication summaries are qualification evidence only and are not endpoint response values.
independent_pre_response_class_support.limitation: Published occupancy summaries are not raw site-year detection counts. Therefore Stage0 may qualify source identity/geometry but final response access remains forbidden unless a pre-response audit accepts this evidence as compatible with the frozen per-partition estimability minima without inspecting model_data.rds.

predeclared_temporal_partition.rule: chronological approximately 50/25/25 split of the 25 documented survey years, fixed without response values

stage0_must_verify: Dryad DOI resolves through the official API and exposes one current published version identity
the version file manifest contains exactly one model_data.rds with immutable file metadata and digest or equivalent immutable identifier
the response file is not downloaded or previewed
the pinned author-repository geometry blob decodes with exact columns SS/longitude/latitude as exactly 114 unique valid site IDs with finite coordinates
geometry yields q20/q40/q60/q80 under the frozen linear-quantile rule and all four thresholds are positive and strictly increasing
README/geometry identities match the pinned author repository commit
no endpoint response bytes, headers, rows, values, models, selector decisions or heldout scores are opened
final_endpoint_contract_may_be_created_o: Stage0 is terminal-success and a separate pre-response class-support audit explicitly establishes compatibility with all frozen estimability minima for the predeclared partition without reading model_data.rds payload
